metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2011 · War Horse
metas.description: A young farm boy enlists to serve in World War I after his beloved horse is sold to the cavalry. His hopeful journey takes him out of England and onto the front lines as the war rages on.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2013 · The Book Thief
metas.description: While subjected to the horrors of World War II Germany, young Liesel finds solace by stealing books and sharing them with others. In the basement of her home, a Jewish refugee is being protected by her adoptive parents.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2014 · The Water Diviner
metas.description: An Australian man travels to Turkey after the Battle of Gallipoli to try to locate his three missing sons.
